name: Document Intelligence Studio
vertical: Shared Services / Back-Office Automation / Intelligent Document Processing
persona: Meridian Shared Services (fictional back-office automation team inside a mid-market enterprise)
tagline: Drop any business document and watch an 8-step pipeline turn it into clean, validated, structured data.
elevatorPitch: A back-office team drops an invoice, a contract, or a pre-authorisation form and — with no per-document template — the pipeline classifies it, reads its layout with a visual LLM, extracts the fields to a schema, and hands back validated JSON, so a task that took an operator ten minutes becomes ten seconds a partner will trust.

corpus.domain: Mixed back-office document intake for a shared-services team — accounts payable, procurement, HR, and claims administration
cornerstoneQueries: What is the total payable on the invoice from vendor Cascade Supply and which cost centre does it map to?
Which vendor contracts renew before the end of Q3 and what are their auto-renewal terms?
Summarise the line items and net-30 terms on the most recent remittance advice.
Which pre-authorisation forms are missing a diagnosis code and need validation?
refusalProbes: What was the vendor's share price on the day this invoice was issued?
What is the personal credit score of the applicant on this resume?
corpus.notes: Each document carries source_doc_type, extraction_schema, and validation_status metadata so the pipeline stages (classify, extract, validate, standardise) all have something to render. Vendors, cost centres and approvers recur across doc types so extracted fields cross-reference into a coherent entity view. Standardised output should be shown in JSON, XML and CSV to prove format-agnostic export.

demoScript.say: Drop a document in cold — no template, no config. The agent classifies what it is.
demoScript.show: Upload a mixed PDF → pipeline step 3 tags it 'vendor invoice' with confidence

demoScript.say: The visual LLM reads the layout the way a person would — tables, stamps, totals — and extracts to a schema.
demoScript.show: Steps 4-5: schema-driven fields populate with bounding-box highlights on the page

demoScript.say: It validates against business rules and standardises to clean structured data.
demoScript.show: Step 8: same extraction exported as JSON, then toggled to XML and CSV

demoScript.say: Now the whole intake is queryable — ask across every document you've processed, grounded and cited.
demoScript.show: Ask: 'which contracts auto-renew before Q3' → cited answer over extracted fields

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — all documents, vendors and identities are synthetic. Not real financial or personal records; extractions are illustrative only.
